description: Golden-run fixture for RandomSampling on the micro DANINHAS dataset (5 classes, 806 train + 209 test images, a 10%-stratified replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ generated by scripts/make_micro_dataset.py). Used by tests/test_golden_run.py to catch integration regressions. See .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 1 and .specs/quality/testing-strategy.md.
git_commit_note: Regenerated 2026-08-23 for the micro-dataset redefinition (chore/micro-10pct): DATA/daninhas_micro/ was redefined from a hand-picked 2-class/70-image subset to a 10%-stratified replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ (all 5 classes, both splits -- see .specs/adr/0004-micro-dataset-and-golden-run.md's 2026-08-23 amendment and files_config/params_micro.json's n_classes: 5). The commit hash above is the branch's parent commit at capture time, before this batch's own commits.

previous_micro_2class_values.note: Values recorded here for the historical record before the 2026-08-23 micro-dataset redefinition (chore/micro-10pct): DATA/daninhas_micro/ used to be a hand-picked 2-class (DATASET_BRACHIARIA, DATASET_GRAMINEA), 25-train/10-test-per-class subset (n_classes=2 in files_config/params_micro.json). It is now a 10%-stratified, all-5-class replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ (n_classes=5), giving a more realistic pre-lab end-to-end check. Indices/metrics below are NOT reproducible against the current DATA/daninhas_micro/ or files_config/params_micro.json -- they describe the old dataset definition only.

notes: Verified deterministic across 2 separate CPU processes on the local dev notebook (no GPU): initial labeled idxs, query idxs, and all metrics in results.json were bit-identical across both runs (this is the same determinism-verification pattern the pre-redefinition fixture used, run again against the redefined dataset).

Indices (initial labeled + queried) are produced purely by numpy's global RNG (np.random.seed(args.seed) + np.random.shuffle/np.random.choice), independent of the ResNet50 forward/backward pass, so their determinism does not depend on CPU floating-point reduction order.

Metrics come from a single ResNet50 (ImageNet-pretrained) epoch of training on 10/15 labeled images at round 0/1, evaluated against 209 test images across 5 classes; with only 1 epoch and a tiny CPU-only setup, round-0/round-1 accuracy (0.215) sits close to 5-class chance (0.2) -- expected for this harder, more realistic 5-class problem versus the old fixture's 2-class chance-level accuracy (0.5), not a regression.

n_classes=5 in files_config/params_micro.json matches DATA/daninhas_micro's 5 class folders (DATASET_BRACHIARIA, DATASET_COLONIAO, DATASET_GRAMINEA, DATASET_MAMONA, DATASET_OUTRAS_FOLHAS_LARGAS); requires downloading ResNet50 ImageNet weights (~98 MB) on first run if not already cached in ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/.

2026-08-23 micro-dataset redefinition (chore/micro-10pct): DATA/daninhas_micro/ was redefined from the old hand-picked 2-class/70-image subset to a 10%-stratified replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ (all 5 classes, both splits, 806 train + 209 test images total), per user request for a more realistic pre-lab/pre-Colab end-to-end check on the no-GPU notebook. scripts/make_micro_dataset.py now selects max(1, floor(0.10 * n_files)) files per (split, class) instead of a fixed 25/10 count for 2 hardcoded classes. DATA/daninhas_micro/ was deleted and regenerated; determinism was re-verified by regenerating it in 2 separate processes (different PYTHONHASHSEED values) and diffing `find DATA/daninhas_micro -type f | sort | sha256sum` (identical digest both times). See previous_micro_2class_values above for the pre-redefinition fixture values.
